I am a woman with one small plot, less than one hectare, and I must feed my family from this maize. I try to buy a little fertilizer when the price is not too high, because our soil here in Mangochi is tired and without it the maize does not give much. I save some chickens and goat droppings from the homestead to put in the planting holes, and I plant together with pumpkins and beans like my mother taught me. I cannot afford to hire many people, so my children and I work the plot ourselves, and my sister helps at weeding time.
